excluded_source_records: Remain intact in the separate G03 staging dataset; no inferred cancellation-to-sale or return links
rules: complete eligible UCI baskets only; original quantities, dates and decimal prices retained
one reconstructed order per invoice; modeled weekday acceptance one to four working days before observed posting
fictional labels, category assignments, suppliers, payment terms and all operational events
one half-up rounding per posted GBP line; no VAT interpretation asserted
partial dispatch for lines >=48 units, followed by a varied weekday second consignment when it existed at the business cutoff
fictional account remittance weekdays, invoice-level timing and varied installments; one receipt may allocate across several invoices
modest opening stock and supplier-specific weekly, carton-sized receipts retrospectively reconstruct a nonnegative stock ledger; future unshipped orders are not invented as historical opening stock
fictional carrier assignments and weekday delivery intervals vary by consignment
sampled service cases follow first dispatch or invoice posting, rotate across support staff, and use varied working-day review intervals
forecasts query only billed units before their target start; future actuals are evaluation only
DEMO namespace supplies authored scenario records, separate from observed customer IDs
startup: Initialize by verified decompression, not regeneration; documents are fixed Markdown artifacts
